procedure: For each seed (1908397192, 939373070, 3203012601), build two simulators with the same population and seed and set the full-rate focus on Bethesda Row.
Warm both up for 100 ticks; record each arm's state hash and the outdoor pedestrians within 150 m (the cohort).
Inject “minor Fire at Bethesda Row” (fire, compiled by the city's scenario compiler) into the treatment arm only.
Run both arms 300 more ticks, recording a bethesda-world-observation/v1 packet every 100 ticks from simulator state.
Report the per-seed treatment minus control differences; R.A.I.N. evaluates the pre-registered criteria.
definition.question: In the Bethesda simulator, how does fire at bethesda_row change watching relative to a matched no-event control?
definition.rationale: Proposed in the R.A.I.N. Lab inside the Bethesda simulation and executed by lop-nur-twin's deterministic city simulator as matched-seed control and treatment arms. The criteria are the lab's fixed rain-criteria/v1 template for the pre-registered metric, direction and minimum effect.
definition.title: Bethesda simulation: Fire at Bethesda Row — Pedestrians watching or recording

controls: same seed and population in both arms
same full-rate focus command at tick 0
same simulator, map, terrain and transit versions
independent: Fire injected at tick 100 (treatment) or not (control)

evaluation.summary: All 2 success criteria held and no failure criterion triggered.
